subject: Commit schedule, exit handling, and co-term impact — updated proposal
messages:
From: Steven Cole <steven.cole@novatherapeutics.com>
To: kimberly_park@redwood.ai
Cc: Elaine Park <elaine.park@novatherapeutics.com>, Markus Schmidt <markus@mgmtconsult.com>
Date: 2026-11-20T09:14:00-08:00
Subject: Exploring multi-year commit + co-terming options

Kim — thanks again for the call this morning. Quick note to capture the ask from our side: we are evaluating a 3-year prepay commitment for inference at scale, with an aggressive ramp in year 1 (50% of committed tokens used in months 1-6, then 80-100%). We care a lot about: term discounts, predictable unit economics as volume ramps, and flexibility if a product pivot requires us to reduce spend.

Specifically can you confirm:
- What discount bands you can extend for a 3-year upfront commit vs annual prepay?
- How you handle early termination / refunds — we want a reasonable pro-rata but also prefer to avoid onerous exit penalties given the size of the commit.
- If we need to co-term this new contract with an existing agreement that ends 09/30/2027, what credits or proration do you support?

We’ve looped in Markus (consultant) and Elaine (legal lead) to help scope redlines. Please share a proposal and a sample SOW we can redline.

Cheers,
Steven
Head of ML Platform
Nova Therapeutics

---
[Attachment: RFP_Nova_Inference_Requirements.pdf (pdf)]

From: kimberly_park@redwood.ai
To: Steven Cole <steven.cole@novatherapeutics.com>
Cc: rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai, vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-11-22T10:06:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Exploring multi-year commit + co-terming options

Steven — thanks for the clear summary. Appreciate the ramp detail; that helps a lot. High-level response below and I attached a draft proposal + SOW for your review.

High-level offer (3-year prepay):
- Effective unit discount: 28% off list for a 3-year upfront commit at your target volume profile.
- Ramp pricing: first 6 months we’ll honor a blended introductory rate (we modeled a 10% premium to the committed unit rate if usage exceeds the 50% ramp assumption — protects both parties).
- Early termination: standard refund with graduated retention — see proposed matrix in the attached SOW (Year 1 refund = 40% of remaining prepay, Year 2 = 60%, Year 3 = none). Refunds net any unpaid usage.
- Co-terming: we can offer a co-term credit to align renewal dates; if you co-term to 09/30/2027 we’ll credit the pro-rated unused portion of the first year against the new contract start, subject to a co-term admin fee.

We tried to balance commercial predictability with flexibility. If legal pushes on refund percentages we can consider alternatives: higher base discount with stricter refund, or a buffer of consumed tokens that are non-refundable.

Attached: Redwood_MultiYear_Pricing_Proposal_v3.pdf, Draft_SOW_Nova_3yr_co-term.docx

Next steps: I suggest a quick align call Wed 11/24 to walk SOW redlines and the refund matrix. Let me know availability.

Best,
Kimberly Park
Senior Sales Manager — Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
(415) 555-0192

From: Elaine Park <elaine.park@novatherapeutics.com>
To: kimberly_park@redwood.ai, Steven Cole <steven.cole@novatherapeutics.com>
Cc: Markus Schmidt <markus@mgmtconsult.com>
Date: 2026-11-24T08:21:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Exploring multi-year commit + co-terming options

Kim / Steven — quick legal redlines after a first pass on the SOW:
- The proposed refund matrix is reasonable in principle but the Year 1 40% retention feels high given it’s a strategic partnership; request Year 1 retention be 25%, Year 2 50%.
- Remove the unilateral right for Redwood to reclassify tokens as non-refundable if usage pattern changes; require mutual agreement for any reclassification.
- Co-term credit: we want the credit to apply to the invoice immediately following co-term (no administrative delay), and to have a clear formula (pro-rated unused $).

We’ll consolidate redlines in Doc track and send by end of day.

Thanks,
Elaine
Legal Counsel, Nova Therapeutics

From: rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
To: kimberly_park@redwood.ai, vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai, aditya_rao@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-11-25T11:42:00-08:00
Subject: Internal: concession options and revenue impact (Nova)

Team — summarizing options after Elaine’s ask. I ran a quick revenue impact model (assumes $18M list over 3 years at target commit).

Option A (our initial): 28% discount, refund retention Y1 40%, Y2 60% => downside NPV ~ $12.9M (net of expected refunds if early exit in Y1).
Option B (concession to legal): 30% discount, refund retention Y1 25%, Y2 50% => downside NPV ~ $12.3M.
Option C (protective language): keep 28% discount, require 90-day buffer of non-refundable committed tokens, retention Y1 30% => downside NPV ~ $12.6M.

Thoughts: Option B gives the customer better protection and buys goodwill; Option C keeps our price but limits exposure with a buffer. If they insist on immediate co-term credit application (no delay), we should increase the admin fee from $5k to $12.5k or add it back into the blended price.

Requesting alignment: which option do we present? I recommend Option C + tighter co-term formula (immediate credit but treat first 90 days as administrative reconciliation window for invoices).

Rishi
Head of Sales — Enterprise

---
On Wed, Nov 25, 2026 at 09:30 AM kimberly_park@redwood.ai wrote:
> Thanks — agree Option C but be prepared to move to B if Elaine pushes.

From: kimberly_park@redwood.ai
To: Steven Cole <steven.cole@novatherapeutics.com>, Elaine Park <elaine.park@novatherapeutics.com>
Cc: rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai, vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai, aditya_rao@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-11-29T14:02:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Exploring multi-year commit + co-terming options — updated SOW attached

Steve / Elaine — thanks for the redlines. We discussed internally and propose the following compromise to move forward quickly: 

Proposal (updated):
- Discount: 29% blended for 3-year prepay (mid-point between our ask and their request).
- Refund matrix (final): Year 1 retention 30%, Year 2 retention 55%, Year 3 none. Refunds = remaining prepaid $ minus invoiced usage and any applicable buffer.
- Buffer: first 90 days of committed tokens considered administrative buffer (non-refundable) to protect provisioning costs; this is capped at 5% of Year 1 committed value.
- Reclassification: Redwood will not unilaterally reclassify token types to make them non-refundable — any reclassification that changes refundability requires mutual written agreement.
- Co-term credit: immediate application on first post-co-term invoice; formula = pro-rated unused $ of the prior agreement, with a $7,500 co-term admin processing fee.

I attached an updated SOW with tracked changes. If this aligns with Nova’s needs, we can prepare an updated signature packet and DocuSign link.

Next steps: sign updated SOW -> Redwood issues invoice for the prepay -> funds applied and contract goes live. Happy to hop on a 30-min call if helpful.

Best,
Kimberly
Senior Sales Manager — Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference

Kim — appreciate the quick work and the compromise, this looks workable. Two final asks before we execute: 
1) Please replace the $7,500 admin fee with an itemized one-time invoice line so we can route it to procurement separately.
2) Confirm invoicing cadence — we’d like a single invoice for the 3-year prepay (as originally requested) but need the invoice to include the co-term credit line item when applicable.

If you can update the SOW with those two operational points we can get legal to sign and I’ll route for executive approval. Assume we are aiming to execute this week.

Thanks,
Steven
